entries.assessment: Audio is a native, settled Spanish media noun (not an untranslated player control); existing ui.canvas.inline_edit.processing_audio = “Procesando audio”. Library category.sounds and canvas.files.audio = “Sonidos” name the broader plural sound group. The different word is justified by the explicitly independent file-media role; no forced “Sonido” change.
Código matches category.code = “Código” and ui.canvas.file_rows.code = “Código”; English Code is correctly localized, not retained.

DOCX is the format acronym and retains official spelling under glossary §1 technology names and the explicit English context. No DOCX legacy value or alternative localized acronym was found in the existing Spanish catalogue; absence is not evidence of a prior spelling.
HTML matches ui.canvas.create_file_dialog.html_html = “HTML (.html)” and html_preview.html_preview = “Vista previa de HTML: {title}”.
Imagen is the correct singular of category.images = “Imágenes”.
Markdown matches ui.canvas.create_file_dialog.markdown_md = “Markdown (.md)” and ui.chat.transcript_copy.menu.copy_markdown = “Copiar como Markdown”.
Otro is the masculine singular corresponding to category.other = “Otros”, referring to archivo/tipo. No interpolation into the generic preview sentence. English metadata M3 only.
PDF matches ui.canvas.pdf_preview.pdf = “PDF: {title}”; standard format acronym remains Latin.

PPTX is a format acronym retained under glossary §1 and the explicit English context. No pre-existing PPTX literal or translated alternative was found in the Spanish catalogue. category.presentations = “Presentaciones” is the broad file group, not an alternate acronym.
Hoja de cálculo is exactly the singular word family of category.spreadsheets = “Hojas de cálculo”. Correct meaning; M1 concerns approximate fit only.
Texto matches preview.pptx_text = “Texto”; appropriate plain-text file label.

Video exactly matches existing ui.library.category.video = “Video”. Canvas already uses “Vídeo”/“Vídeos” (file_rows.video/files.videos), so the existing catalogue is split in accent variant; both Spanish forms are valid. Matching the immediate Library group is justified and does not introduce the split. No demand to recertify or normalize legacy values.

entries.source: This file has no in-app preview here.
entries.current_text: Este archivo no tiene vista previa en la app.
entries.assessment: Grammatical standalone sentence, no kind named and no placeholder. Preserves the existing unsupported sentence’s “no tiene vista previa en la app”; este archivo replaces un archivo de tipo {kind}. The English here is already conveyed by en la app in this UI, not a missing capability qualifier.
Personalizado naturally labels the masculine grupo/tipo of user-defined tags; existing custom_size = “Tamaño personalizado”. M2 is fit only.
Formato accurately labels file-format taxonomy; official format names remain unaltered.
Proyecto matches glossary project → proyecto and ui.projects.project_list.project = “Proyecto”.
Origen is byte-identical to ui.library.filter.source = “Origen”; distinct tag group role is preserved by placement.
Estado is byte-identical to ui.library.filter.status and ui.projects.project_list.status = “Estado”.
Tema is the ordinary neutral Spanish noun for a subject-matter category; no conflicting established term was found in the scoped neighbouring catalogues.
Tipo matches ui.library.sort.kind = “Tipo” and ui.canvas.files.kind = “Tipo”. Two independently placed concepts sharing this Spanish noun is natural and not a semantic defect.
